content.name: Mind Blank
entries: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the {@condition charmed} condition. The spell even foils {@spell wish} spells and spells or effects of similar power used to affect the target's mind or to gain information about the target.

content.name: Mind Blank
entries: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Psychic damage and the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition. The target is also unaffected by anything that would sense its emotions or alignment, read its thoughts, or magically detect its location, and no spell—not even {@spell Wish|SRD52}—can gather information about the target, observe it remotely, or control its mind.
